source.title: Larne Times, 19 May 1949, p. 5 ("No interest shown: Larne R.D.C. elections")
source.publisher: Larne Times (via the British Newspaper Archive)

note: Triennial election of the 16 electoral divisions of Larne rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. There were no contests: only five divisions returned nomination papers, and the retiring members in the others were deemed re-elected. M. J. Hawkins was the only new member, for Islandmagee South. New member, in place of H. J. S. Milliken, J.P., who retired after 20 years' service. Returned unopposed.
